answer: A sybil-resistant economy ties every identity to a human-verified anchor and a stake that scales with claimed influence, so cloning across a canyon of fakes costs real value each copy. Reputation earned through peer-verified work is non-transferable, so a fresh clone starts silent as a whisper and must rebuild from zero. A public bridge of confirmed duplicates is cosigned by honest peers, dropping the attacker's expected gain below the per-identity cost and making mass forgery strictly unprofitable.
